card.name: Unavailability, waiting and interruption phrases
card.fires_on: Words in phrases about being unable, unavailable or having to wait, such as "isn't available", "can't reply", "can't interrupt", and "wait until they ask". Also "without" after "falling asleep".

modes.label: Can't / unavailable
modes.description: Negation or unavailability right after a subject, as in not being able to do something.
modes.example: Regrettably, I can't reply to every letter<<,>> but I greatly appreciate your feedback

modes.label: Waiting and interrupting
modes.description: Words in advice about waiting for a turn or not interrupting.
modes.example: Waiting<< for>> their turn can be a very difficult task

modes.label: Falling asleep without warning
modes.description: The word "without" after reports of suddenly falling asleep.
modes.example: have reported suddenly falling asleep<< without>> prior warning of sleepiness while engaged in

card.writes: It lowers the odds of dawn, wake and night-time words (English and Chinese), plus some odd word pieces.
card.plain: It marks spots in text about not being able to do something, waiting, or sudden sleep, and pushes against morning and night words.
